ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Wget.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses using Wget.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\wget\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "wget\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX("://[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-O\s") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-output\\-document.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.ps1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.msi\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.bat\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.exe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbs\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.vbe\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.hta\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.dll\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1\\$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\\.psm1\\$")))
